basic_profile.bio: A recent college graduate from Dublin, Ireland, with a passion for anime and manga, especially 'Attack on Titan'. I spend my free time diving into complex theories and discussions on various fandoms. I'm currently exploring the world of cryptocurrencies, focusing on Bitcoin and its impact in the UK. I'm single and enjoy late-night browsing, often active between 10 PM to 2 AM GMT. By day, I work part-time at a local library, which fuels my love for literature and theoretical discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in English Literature, which has honed my analytical skills and love for storytelling. My interest in cryptocurrencies began during a university seminar on digital economies. I am largely self-taught in this area, through online forums and subreddits like 'BitcoinUK'. My anime and manga insights stem from years of dedicated fandom and participation in online communities.
